statement.text: Let ''D=(V,A)'' be a digraph whose underlying graph is [[Partition connectivity|''k''-partition-connected]], and let <math>r_0 \in V</math> be a  node of in-degree 0. Suppose that the in-degree of every other node is at least ''k''. Is it true that ''D'' can be decomposed into ''k'' weakly connected spanning subgraphs, so that every node <math>v \in V-r_0</math> has positive in-degree in each subgraph?
